request: I'm in Chicago for the two-week program at the agricultural research center. On the free weekend I want to fly to Seattle on Saturday, February 13th, to see my sister, and come back Sunday. Could you book Chicago to Seattle for Saturday?

trip.campus: UNL Panhandle Research, Extension and Education Center, Scottsbluff (drives to Denver to fly)
trip.purpose: Visiting his sister in Seattle over the free weekend of a two-week program in Chicago

trip_request.covers: Two-week training program in Chicago, February 8-19; a personal weekend trip is disclosed and its costs left out

sign_offs.name: Lori Baca
sign_offs.subject: TRIP_REQUEST
sign_offs.covers: The trip request, approved; the funding is budgeted

must_keep.quote: Travelers who engage in personal travel, while in Travel Status, should acknowledge and include information concerning personal travel in the Pre-Trip Request to the extent reasonably necessary to facilitate and comply with this Travel Policy. However, only University business-related travel expenses should be included in the Pre-Trip Request and expense reports. Following the trip, the University will pay for or reimburse the Traveler for the portion of the expenses that relate to the University-related business purpose of the trip. All personal expenses and related taxes, tips and fees should be deducted by the Traveler from the submitted, detailed receipts.
must_keep.why: personal travel in Travel Status: only the business portion is paid

must_keep.quote: The University will pay for and reimburse reasonable, necessary and approved travel and expenses incurred in the performance of University business in accordance with this travel policy.
must_keep.why: the University pays for travel in the performance of University business

distractors.quote: The University has the ability to pay directly for approved travel expenses for airfare
distractors.why: the University may pay the agency directly; not a fare rule

design_notes: Lines 164-170: personal travel while in Travel Status is disclosed in the request, but only University business-related expenses are paid. The Seattle weekend is wholly personal: buy nothing. The program's approvals are on file but unused (rule 4(b)).
